title: Pollen and airway inflammation
body: Pollen exposure can trigger allergic inflammation in the airways, increasing bronchial hyperresponsiveness and symptom risk in sensitized individuals with asthma.

title: Cold air and humidity
body: Cold, dry air and rapid temperature changes can provoke bronchoconstriction. High humidity may worsen symptoms for some patients while low humidity can irritate airways.

title: Air quality and asthma
body: Elevated particulate matter and air pollution indices are associated with increased asthma symptoms and rescue medication use. Follow your action plan when AQI is poor.

title: Nighttime symptoms
body: Nocturnal symptoms suggest suboptimal asthma control and may precede daytime worsening. Persistent night symptoms warrant review with your care team per GINA guidelines.

title: Rescue inhaler use
body: Increased short-acting beta-agonist use indicates worsening control. Three or more days of increased rescue use per week is a signal to escalate per asthma action plans.
